notes.title: HITM3's soundtrack is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893840/be787ac3074cb08a660b4ea1796d04ea73ce3c79.jpg[/img]

[url=https://akaxiri.bandcamp.com/album/hitm3-soundtrack]The soundtrack for HITM3 is now out![/url]

Today marks 5 years from Nam's first nightly adventure in HITME. Let's celebrate and dance along the tracks of their latest departure. If you enjoy the music, please be sure to support and follow the artists.  HITM3's soundtrack is made with tracks by Lia Nadja, Niñosindigo, Lavina Yelb, Vicente Palma, paltamango, leorina  & mariapepinos.  

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NH4RkPpDUA0]It's been 5 years since Nam accidentally met Astra & Dei.[/url] So to celebrate this serendipity, HITM3 will be on sale for the next week. Thank you so much for sharing our time together, for your comments and reviews, I'll treasure each of them for when the silence comes again. I really hope the summer and winter is treating you well.

Big, big hugs,

Xiri
